order: retire; deterministic tick-based emission; evaluate shared analytic ambient flow and compact body guide; exact frozen-target velocity relaxation; trapezoidal position update once; age/size/concentration; ground
random: uint32 wrapping mix32; uniform=hash/2^32. Inputs seed,region,tick,channel; no frame/stream randomness
pool: Separate capacities; reject newest birth when full; never move or evict live particles. Stable ID=kind*2^30+region*100000+tick; reset on new event, combine with external event ID for overlapping events.
pause_reset: pause performs no steps and accrues no time; reset clears clock, particles, births and accumulator. Fixed1/120s steps; advance accumulates wall time without dropping steps. Caller owns catch-up budgeting.

scenarios.wind_turn: diagnostic rigid whole-body yaw .65*S((t-1.15)/1.3); same births/local clocks/support/late rolls; wind smoothsteps at1.4..2.05s toward(-.15,.03,.75)m/s. Previously released particle positions are never transformed.

following: guide kernels around current moving source anchors, blended parent material velocities, exp(-particleAge/.45) attenuation; zero outside .48m and after emission. Never reparent particles.
runtime: Python+NumPy reference, not Rust/WGSL. Analytic ambient/curl is a practical approximation, never samples the exported Pyro reference. Client supplies terrain, event IDs, wind/local influence fields, GPU rendering and scene-depth/volume composition.
